[ASSISTANT_SAID] Blurb offers pre-designed templates for specific occasions, customizable layouts, a wide range of fonts, colors, and backgrounds, and the ability to add text and photos.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Blurb's features include a bookstore for selling photo books, PDF and eBook options, and volume discounts for bulk orders.
